notes.Datadog: No new-grad SWE req live on its Greenhouse board as of 10/20 (its New Grad SWE usually posts in late summer). SWE I base is about $143K (Levels.fyi). Ask at booth whether the 2027 req is coming.
notes.Microsoft: Microsoft's own search hides new-grad roles under plain titles; rows come from the Simplify new-grad list. Check careers.microsoft.com 'Students and graduates'.
notes.Apple: Apple posts new-grad roles without 'new grad' in the title; rows come from the Simplify new-grad list (Apple pages give base pay).
notes.Nintendo of America: No 2027 new-grad posting found. Redmond NTD hires mostly contract Associate SWE roles ($50-81/hr).
notes.Navy Federal Credit Union: No 2027 full-time new-grad tech program found; Summer Associate internships + a Finance Rotation Program.
notes.Pacific Northwest National Lab: Hires Post-Bachelor Research Associates (all majors) year-round; pay not public. Ask the recruiter.
notes.Ford Motor Company: Ford College Graduate (FCG) program usually posts Sep-Oct; no 2027 req or pay range found yet.
notes.Edwards Lifesciences: Only 2027 co-ops and internships so far (CA intern base $54-72K annualized); interns convert into New Grad Programs.
notes.Burns & McDonnell: Its '2027 EE entry-level - express interest' req closed 8/21. Entry EE base is roughly $63-85K (PayScale). Ask about late-cycle openings.
notes.Lenovo: No 2027 new-grad posting found (Morrisville NC is the US hub).
notes.Delta Air Lines: Runs rotational/co-op programs on its Avature site; no 2027 tech new-grad req found.
notes.Mitsubishi Power Americas: No US 2027 new-grad program found; IGNITE internship (mostly ME).
notes.Exponent: Consulting engineers; usually hires MS/PhD. Associate pay averages about $115K (Indeed).
notes.ASML: No US full-time new-grad posting found; summer 2027 internships at Wilton CT / San Diego expected this fall.
notes.onsemi: No US 2027 new-grad posting found (NCG programs are mainly in Asia).
notes.ExxonMobil: Careers search shows only 'Students Seeking Full-Time Employment in Trading' (Spring, TX) for 2027 US; engineering campus hiring usually goes through university recruiting.
notes.Lockheed Martin: lockheedmartinjobs.com blocks automated search; use the site's 'Early careers' filter for live reqs.
